title: 第618章 真是不自量力第617章 不是城主大人
slug: 无敌帝祖第620章一剑杀了
content_zh:
巨峭城中心，偌大演武广场。
皇帝萧不凡的雕像屹立在中间，阳光照耀之下，弥漫着金色光芒，令人忍不住生出顶礼膜拜的感觉。
广场周围，人声鼎沸，早已经聚集着密密麻麻的身影，他们都是来观看巨峭城比武大会的人。
“我听说今年的巨峭城比武大会，好像有执法队队长参加。”
“我也听说了，据说之前天云山出现嗜血魔教分舵，执法队恰好在天云山剿灭嗜血魔教分舵，也就留下来观看比武大会。”
“也就是来凑凑热闹，不然结局早已注定，肯定又是巨鲸帮获得第一。”
“什么第一，我感觉前三都要被巨鲸帮包揽。”
“本来之前城主府还有蒋深，现在蒋深都已经加入巨鲸帮，成为真传弟子了。”
不少围观的人，纷纷窃窃私语。
都觉得巨鲸帮肯定能获得比武大会第一。
“巨鲸帮来了！”
突然，一阵阵脚步声传来，只见数十个人，穿着清一色的黑白相间的衣袍，为首的中年男子，身材瘦高，面容枯槁，双眼眼球很小，整个人走在前面，犹如一条毒蛇一般。
他就是巨鲸帮帮主乔焕之，真武境四重修为，实力比巨峭城的城主潘威，都还要略高一筹。
身后跟着两个满脸皱纹的老者，分别是巨鲸帮的左右护法，两人都是真武境一重巅峰修为。
其余的不少人则是巨鲸帮的执事，都是造化境修为。
紧随其后还有十来个青年，身上气息都很强，为首的青年男子，整个人披着头发，面容惨白，两只手掌更是如同白纸，显得很诡异。
他就是巨鲸帮的少帮主乔津，乃是巨峭城近百年难得一遇的天之骄子，修为已经达到元婴境九重巅峰。
今年参加肯定会代表巨鲸帮参加西南九郡大比，到时候必然大放异彩，极有可能杀进天骄榜前十。
“我怎么感觉乔津的修为，好像又提升了？他该不会在西南九郡大比之前，突破到造化境吧？”有人盯着乔津，忍不住深吸一口气，神色间都是惊讶。
“你感受的没错，这家伙的修为，已经无限接近于半步造化境。”旁边的男子闻言，点了点头道。

“若是乔津真能够突破造化境，肯定能够在西南九郡大比大放异彩，到时候巨鲸帮名声大噪，以后怕是要彻底崛起。”得到肯定的答复后，不少人神色间，流露出羡慕之色。
“你们说乔津会不会参加比武大会？”
听到几人议论乔津的实力，有人出言猜测。
“他应该没必要参加，谁都知道他的实力很强。况且今年巨峭城的比武大会，根本无需他出面，就凭巨鲸帮的三大真传弟子，就足以横扫全场。”旁边的人摇了摇头说道。
“哟？真是稀客，想不到袁大队长也来观看我们巨峭城的比武大会，真是令人激动。”
乔焕之带着巨鲸帮的众人，来到演武广场的观众席，目光瞥见袁畅等人之时，脸上立刻浮现出笑容，赶紧迎上去打招呼。
双眸不着痕迹的扫过袁畅身后的骆俪和柳浮等人，神色深处深处都弥漫着惊讶之色。
“乔帮主抬举了，袁某恰好路过巨峭城，有这样的热闹，自然要来凑凑。”袁畅面色淡然地道。
content_en:
In the center of Juqiao City, there is a huge martial arts square.
The statue of Emperor Xiao Bufan stands in the middle. Under the sunlight, it is filled with golden light, making people feel like they are worshiping.
There was a buzz of people around the square, and dense figures had already gathered. They were all coming to watch the Juqiao City Martial Arts Tournament.
"I heard that this year's Giant Cliff City Tournament seems to have the captain of the law enforcement team participating."
"I've heard about it too. It's said that there was a bloodthirsty demon cult branch in Tianyun Mountain before. The law enforcement team happened to wipe out the bloodthirsty demon cult branch in Tianyun Mountain, so they stayed to watch the competition."
"I just came to join in the fun, otherwise the outcome has already been determined, and the Giant Whale Gang will definitely win the first place again."
"What's number one? I feel like the top three will be taken by the Whale Gang."
"Originally, there was Jiang Shen in the City Lord's Mansion before, but now Jiang Shen has joined the Giant Whale Gang and has become a true disciple."
Many people watching were whispering.
They all felt that the Giant Whale Gang would definitely win the first place in the tournament.
"The Whale Gang is coming!"
Suddenly, bursts of footsteps came, and dozens of people were seen, wearing uniform black and white robes. The middle-aged man at the head was tall and thin, with a haggard face and small eyes. He walked in front, like a poisonous snake.
He is Qiao Huanzhi, the leader of the Giant Whale Gang. He is at the fourth level of the True Martial Realm. His strength is slightly higher than Pan Wei, the lord of Giant Cliff City.
Behind him were two wrinkled old men, the left and right guardians of the Giant Whale Gang. Both of them were at the peak of the first level of the True Martial Realm.
Many of the others are the deacons of the Giant Whale Gang, and they are all at the Creation Realm.
Following closely behind were a dozen young men with very strong auras. The young man at the head had his hair disheveled, his face was pale, and his two palms were as white as paper, which looked very strange.
He is Qiao Jin, the young leader of the Giant Whale Gang. He is a rare and proud man in Giant Cliff City in the past hundred years. His cultivation has reached the peak of the ninth level of the Nascent Soul Realm.
If you participate this year, you will definitely represent the Giant Whale Gang in the nine-county competition in the southwest. You will definitely shine when the time comes, and you will most likely reach the top ten on the Prodigy List.
"Why do I feel that Qiao Jin's cultivation level seems to have improved again? Could he have broken through to the realm of creation before the competition between the nine southwest counties?" Someone stared at Qiao Jin and couldn't help but take a deep breath, with expressions of surprise.
"You are right. This guy's cultivation is already very close to the Half-Step Creation Realm." The man next to him nodded after hearing this.
"If Qiao Jin can really break through the realm of creation, he will definitely be able to shine in the competition in the nine southwest counties. By then, the Giant Whale Gang will become famous and may rise completely in the future." After receiving a positive answer, many people looked envious.
"Do you think Qiao Jin will participate in the martial arts tournament?"
After hearing several people talking about Qiao Jin's strength, some people made speculations.
"There should be no need for him to participate. Everyone knows that he is very powerful. Besides, this year's martial arts competition in Giant Cliff City does not require his presence at all. The three true disciples of the Giant Whale Gang are enough to sweep the whole place." The person next to him shook his head and said.
"Hey? What a rare visitor. I didn't expect Captain Yuan to come to watch our martial arts competition in Giant Cliff City. It's really exciting."
Qiao Huanzhi led everyone from the Giant Whale Gang to the auditorium of Yanwu Square. When he caught sight of Yuan Chang and others, a smile immediately appeared on his face and he hurried up to greet them.
His eyes swept over Luo Li, Liu Fu and others behind Yuan Chang without leaving a trace, their expressions filled with surprise.
"Thank you, Gang Leader Qiao. Yuan happened to be passing by Juqiao City. With such a bustle, he naturally wanted to join in." Yuan Chang said with a calm expression.
